CustomField.description: JSON-based conditional visibility rules for this page section, the same shape as the page field. When configured, the whole section (frame, header and fields) is shown or hidden at runtime based on Form_Submission__c field values.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Conditional logic rules that control when this section is visible. Configure via the Conditional Logic tab on the record page or the Customize modal in the Form Template builder.
CustomField.label: Conditional Logic
